test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (JSO) 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: For any two events A and B, if P(A|B) = 0.6 and P(B|A) = 0.4, then what is the value of (P(A))/(P(B))?
solution:
**The correct answer is - __0.5__**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ **

__
 
• **P(A|B)__** represents the conditional probability of event A occurring given that event B has occurred.
 
• **__P(B|A)__** represents the conditional probability of event B occurring given that event A has occurred.
 
• We are given that **__P(A|B) = 0.6__** and **__P(B|A) = 0.4__**.
 
• We are tasked with finding **__P(A) / P(B)__**.
 
• The formula that relates these probabilities is: **__P(A|B) = P(A) * P(B|A) / P(B)__**.
 
• By rearranging this equation, we get **__P(A) / P(B) = P(A|B) / P(B|A)__**.
 
• Substituting the given values into this equation: **__P(A) / P(B) = 0.6 / 0.4 = 1.5__**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__ **

__
 
• **Conditional Probability__** is the probability of an event occurring given that another event has occurred.
 
• **__P(A|B)__** is calculated as **__P(A|B) = P(A and B) / P(B)__**.
 
• **__P(B|A)__** is calculated as **__P(B|A) = P(A and B) / P(A)__**.
 
• Understanding how conditional probabilities work is key for solving problems involving two events that are dependent on each other.
 
• The equation **__P(A|B) = P(A) * P(B|A) / P(B)__** can be used for problems involving both conditional probabilities and the calculation of **__P(A) / P(B)__**.
